title: Add release team: ros_misc_utilities
author: berndpfrommer
body:
* Name of the new release team: ros_misc_utilities
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [ffmpeg_image_transport_msgs](https://github.com/ros-misc-utilities/ffmpeg_image_transport_msgs)
    * [ffmpeg_image_transport_msgs (humble)](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6efee826f8b194f3cf9f708dfee813c4066c3192/humble/distribution.yaml#L1794)
    * [ffmpeg_image_transport_msgs (iron)](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6efee826f8b194f3cf9f708dfee813c4066c3192/iron/distribution.yaml#L1431)
    * [ffmpeg_image_transport_msgs (rolling)](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6efee826f8b194f3cf9f708dfee813c4066c3192/rolling/distribution.yaml#L1396)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>
  * [ffmpeg_image_transport](https://github.com/ros-misc-utilities/ffmpeg_image_transport)
    * [ffmpeg_image_transport (humble)](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6efee826f8b194f3cf9f708dfee813c4066c3192/humble/distribution.yaml#L1784)
    * [ffmpeg_image_transport (iron)](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6efee826f8b194f3cf9f708dfee813c4066c3192/iron/distribution.yaml#L1421)
    * [ffmpeg_image_transport (rolling)](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6efee826f8b194f3cf9f708dfee813c4066c3192/rolling/distribution.yaml#L1386)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>

* Team members
  * [@berndpfrommer](https://github.com/ros-misc-utilities/ffmpeg_image_transport/blob/74c7b9bc5c26f51a255e3731d3d546dcf4bf6394/package.xml#L10)

comments.author: berndpfrommer
comments.body:
Just realized now that this was added as "ffmpeg_image_transport_team" as opposed to "ros_misc_utilities" team as requested.
Sure enough, this caused confusion later when adding more repositories to the team. Now we have in #488 the ffmpeg_image_transport_tools repository added to the ""misc_utilities" team.
So we have two teams now: "ffmpeg_image_transport_team" and the "misc_utilities" team, neither of which matches the original requested "ros_misc_utilities" (which I chose to be the name of the github organization).
Can we merge these two teams into one (called "ros_misc_utilities")?
Thanks!
